title: The roster now finishes opening
summary: Fix the Changes render error that appeared as a shared-roster connection failure.
changes: Live testing confirmed that shared data loaded successfully before the Changes allocation control stopped rendering with an undefined plan.
The control now derives the selected night's staffing plan before deciding whether confirmation choices should appear.
A deterministic seven-nurse render check covers the exact state that exposed the failure.
No changes to roster, staffing, allocation, Pager, Reliever, five-nurse, realtime, privacy, database schema or write rules.
